# Motion v2: art the app still needs (owner's pack)

Started in MV3 (19 Oct 2026). The motion milestones use only the owner's
`DODDY-Numbered-Video-Assets-v01` pack (`UploadedDoddy_*`, `WholeDoddy_*`, `DoddyMotion_*`; CLAUDE.md,
"Character art"). Nothing here is drawn, traced or generated by an agent. The owner allowed moving,
scaling, rotating and squashing a whole pack picture (Q7); anything else needs new art from the
owner's illustrator. Source: `MOTION_V2_PLAN.md` section 3; each milestone adds what it found.

## How the app chooses a picture today (MV3)

`Packages/DoddyCore/Sources/DoddyCore/Motion/MotionArt.swift`, tested in `MotionHostTests`:

| What the engine is doing | Picture shown |
|---|---|
| Standing, breathing off | `DoddyMotion_idle_1` |
| Crouch before a hop | `DoddyMotion_jump_1` (mirrored when he faces left) |
| Take-off (first 30 % of the flight) / apex and fall | `DoddyMotion_jump_2` / `_3` (mirrored when travelling left) |
| Contact, settle (not under Reduce Motion) | `DoddyMotion_jump_4` for 90 ms, then `_5` until 280 ms |
| Sitting (empty Memories, empty Lists) | `WholeDoddy_crosslegged` |
| A screen-wide problem on his screen | `WholeDoddy_facepalm` (ADR-299 meaning) |
| Listening (MV5, only from the voice session's real `.listening` phase) | `WholeDoddy_listening` |

MV5 (19 Oct 2026) adds:

| What the engine is doing | Picture shown |
|---|---|
| Three breaths | `DoddyMotion_idle_1` to `_4` on the way in, back to `_1` on the way out, one breath per 4.2 s (whether frame 4 is the deepest breath is to be checked by eye) |
| The welcome (once a day) and the wave (the session's playful moment) | `DoddyMotion_wave_1` to `_5`, 140 ms each, resting on frame 5 (as ADR-380's wave). The brief's welcome is eyes and a head roll, which the pack can't draw (Q15) |
| The stretch (playful moment while sitting) | `WholeDoddy_yawn_stretch` for the whole gesture |
| Thinking in Ask (no reply after 600 ms) | `WholeDoddy_kneeling_inspect` |
| An upward flick, the 3-day welcome hop | The hop strip, in place |
| Touch-down dip, drag-lean | Squash and tilt of the current picture (Q7) |

Squash on landing and the lean are transforms of the whole current picture (Q7).

## Missing, and what the app does instead

| Needed by the brief | Pack today | What the app does until it exists |
|---|---|---|
| Gaze: pupils in 8 directions plus centre, on a front head that matches every body ("eyes first", glances, eyes following a finger, thinking's eyes up and right) | Nothing imported; an eye-direction sheet may exist at pack 008 (heads only) | No gaze at all. `MotionHost.focusPoint()` returns nothing, so the engine never asks for one. Not faked with a whole-pose turn. |
| Blink, and the slow 280 ms blink | Possibly pack 007 (heads only), not imported | No blink. |
| Eyes closed in contentment | `WholeDoddy_yawn_stretch` has closed eyes but yawns with raised arms | Not shown. |
| Squint on touch | None | Not shown (MV5's touch-down dip is a whole-picture squash only). |
| Head rub: eyes closed, head tipping with the stroke | None | A stroke across his head is a drag (lean) only. |
| Stand-up from sitting, sit-down to cross-legged | Sit strip (017) sits on a box | He cuts between standing and `WholeDoddy_crosslegged`. |
| The rest of the stretch: onto his toes, eyes closed for 200 ms | `WholeDoddy_yawn_stretch` yawns, feet flat | The yawn-and-stretch pose stands in for the whole stretch. |
| Head roll (welcome 5°, introduce −8°, thinking 4°) | None; only a whole-figure tilt | The default and evening welcomes are not played. |
| Two shuffle step poses | `DoddyMotion_walk_*` is side-on travel, which the brief forbids for moving around | Every move is a hop. |
| Brace, arms out, both feet down | `WholeDoddy_oneleg_balance` lifts a foot | No brace picture; he stays in his standing picture. |
| Sitting on an edge, legs hanging, no box | `DoddyMotion_sit_5` has the box drawn in | Not used; removing the box would be an edit. |
| Standing up from cross-legged (140 ms) | None | He cuts from the cross-legged picture to the crouch. |
| A front pointing arm, low (about −40°), for "introduce the draft" and "trace the source" | `VoiceDoddy_talking_1`, `WholeDoddy_reaching_high` are the closest | Not shown (no draft panel exists either). |
| Standing thinking pose, glove at the chin (optional) | `WholeDoddy_kneeling_inspect` kneels | MV5 decides; kneeling can't stand on a moving edge. |
| Larger exports for 1.4× on Home (Q11) | `DoddyMotion_*` and `WholeDoddy_*` are 300 × 450 px at @3x | Drawn upscaled about 15 % on Home: a little soft. The 1024 × 1536 originals can be re-exported with `tools/whole_doddy/build_imagesets.py` (cuts and downscales only). |

## Asked of the owner

1. A gaze set and a blink as a separate head (or eye) layer that fits every body pose, or the bodies
   redrawn with the head separate. That is a drawing decision for the illustrator.
2. The poses in the table above, as whole pictures at 1024 × 1536 like the rest of the pack.
3. Whether to re-export the existing poses larger for Home's 1.4× (Q11).
